problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}p+3q=2 \\ 9p-4q=1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

activity_context.topic_title: Systems of Equations as Augmented Matrices

examples.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a Linear System With Variables Other Than x, y, z
examples.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/d89417b7eb2d000bbd81fcf4a89ca7eaa5529fc56d9b41bf6e8bb237d2eb9e16.png)
examples.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $a,b,c,d$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/93874fa93cfd9ef3df1492bbc35056c2381157740d8ca26b475474faf54ee4d1.png)

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & \frac{1}{2} & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & -4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/8356d9148bc06d76a5aee41e4a07651c43d94b2496d9542eb8b6e01ee52ea161.png)

feedback.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & 10 \\ -2 & -3 & -15\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$ and  $y$,  the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}x-5y=10 \\ -2x-3y=-15\end{aligned}
$$
